## Course description

- Time: 23h
- Year: 2025
- Instructor: Sopheap Oeng
- Email: sopheap15@gmail.com

This course introduces viruses structure, replication, pathogenesis and diagnostic methods in clinical labroratory. It also covers important human viruses including _Herpesviridae_, _Hepatitis viruses_, _Togaviruses_, _Flaviviruses_ and _Orthomyxoviruses_.

## Course learning outcomes

- Distinguish viral morphology and structure
- Explain viral multiplication and pathogenesis
- Identify diagnostic methods used in microbiology labs
- Describe control, prevention and treatment strategies
